title: Other problems (problem 1)
statement: (Z. Patakfalvi) Consider $f: \mathfrak{X} \to T$(smooth projective curve), assume the general fiber is unifrom K-stable. Let $c_{nef}:=$ minimum of $c$ such that $-K_{\mathfrak{X}/T}+c \cdot f^* (t)$ is nef. Find an effective upper bound of $c_{nef}$ in terms of $\delta, \mathrm{vol}$ of general fiber.
source_name: AimPL: K-stability and related topics

title: Local cohomology in characteristic p
statement: Given an F-finite F-module, how can one efficiently compute a unit F-module? For example, given the map $\mathrm{Ext}^i(R/I,R)\to \mathrm{Ext}^i(R/I^{[p]},R)$, how can one find a root for the local cohomology module $H^i_I(R)$?
source_name: AimPL: Macaulay2: expanded functionality and improved efficiency

title: Can we compute the n-th step of a resolution quickly, without computing the previous steps?
statement: Can we compute the n-th step of a resolution quickly, without computing the previous steps?
source_name: AimPL: Macaulay2: expanded functionality and improved efficiency

title: Can we compute all the degree-0 (or degree-≤ e) homomorphisms of a graded module M without computing the entirety of End M?
statement: Can we compute all the degree-0 (or degree-≤ e) homomorphisms of a graded module M without computing the entirety of End M? What are other ways to speed up the decomposition of modules into indecomposable summands? If M is the direct sum of $N_1$ and $N_2$, how can we extract $\mathrm{End}(N_1)$ and $\mathrm{End}(N_2)$ from $\mathrm{End}(M)$ without recalculating?
source_name: AimPL: Macaulay2: expanded functionality and improved efficiency

title: Wall-crossing for Calabi-Yau varieties (problem 4)
statement: Let $X$ be a Fano 3-fold, and $p:Y\to X$ an elliptically fibered Calabi-Yau 4-fold. Compute invariants, or prove correspondences on $X$ by performing wall-crossing on $Y$, with respect to classes on $Y$ pulled back from $p$.
source_name: AimPL: Wall-crossing: techniques and applications

title: Rank-reduction wall-crossing (problem 2)
statement: Let $S$ be a surface of general type. Use wall-crossing to find an explicit (possibly conjectural) formula for rank $r=4$ Vafa-Witten invariants of $S$.
source_name: AimPL: Wall-crossing: techniques and applications

title: Find some formulation of Virasoro constraints for moduli spaces of sheaves on orbifolds, and prove them using wall-crossing techniques as in Bojko-Lim-Moreira.
statement: Find some formulation of Virasoro constraints for moduli spaces of sheaves on orbifolds, and prove them using wall-crossing techniques as in Bojko-Lim-Moreira.
source_name: AimPL: Wall-crossing: techniques and applications

title: Variational problems for dilatation functionals
statement: Study extremal variational problems for dilatation functionals of mappings. For instance, find the extremal domain (and possibly also the extremal mappings) associated to the configuration of a doubly connected planar domain including an obstacle of prescribed diameter.
source_name: AimPL: Mapping theory in metric spaces (posed by Melkana Brakalova)

title: Compact deformations of minimizing sets
statement: An $m$-rectifiable closed set $S \subset V = \ell^\infty_n$ is called {\it minimizing} if for every Lipschitz map $f:V\to V$ such that $f$ is the identity off a cube $C$ and $f(C)\subset C$, ${\mathcal H}^m(C\cap S) \le {\mathcal H}^m(f(C\cap S))$. Let $S$ be minimizing. Is it true that for ${\mathcal H}^m$-almost every $x \in S$, there exists a neighborhood $U$ of $x$ such that $S\cap U$ is a Lipschitz graph over an $m$-dimensional subspace $\Pi$ of $V$?
source_name: AimPL: Mapping theory in metric spaces (posed by Thierry De Pauw)

title: Matrix Theory (problem 2)
statement: Find a simple proof of BMV conjecture for $3\times 3$ matrices (and an explicit formula for the BMV measure for $3\times 3$ matrices; the existence of the measure is due to recent work of Stahl).
source_name: AimPL: Stability and hyperbolicity (posed by P.~Moussa)

title: Matrix Theory (problem 3)
statement: Given $p\in\mathbb{C}[x]$, $\deg(p) = n$, find an $n\times n$ Hermitian matrix whose inertia $(n_+, n_{-}, n_0)$ counts the zeros of $p$ in $H_+, H_{-}, H_0=\mathbb{R}$.
source_name: AimPL: Stability and hyperbolicity (posed by A.~Sokal)

title: Mappings (problem 1)
statement:
Given proper holomorphic maps $f,g: \mathbb{B}^n\to \mathbb{B}^N$, how does one show that $f$ and $g$ are not homotopic? Find homotopy invariants for proper holomorphic maps between balls.

$\bullet$ Special case (Lebl): Is the Faran map from $\mathbb{B}^2$ to $\mathbb{B}^4$ given by 
$$
(z,w) \to (z^3,\sqrt{3}zw, w^3,0)
$$
 homotopic to the map $(z,w)\to (z,w, 0, 0)$?
source_name: AimPL: Cauchy-Riemann equations in several variables (posed by D'Angelo)

title: Mappings (problem 2)
statement:
Let $R(z,\overline{z})$ be a bihomogeneous polynomial. Find necessary and sufficient conditions such that there exists an integer $N$ with 

$$
(R(z,\overline{z}))^N=\sum_{j=1}^{m}|p_j(z)|^2.
$$

Here $p_j(z)$'s are linearly independent holomorphic polynomials. See and.
source_name: AimPL: Cauchy-Riemann equations in several variables (posed by D'Angelo)

title: Determine the boundary behavior of the Bergman kernel on Reinhardt domains.
statement: Determine the boundary behavior of the Bergman kernel on Reinhardt domains. In particular, assume that the domain is smooth, complete and finite type. Start with the domains $\left\{|z_1|^2+|z_2|^{2q}<1\right\}$ and $\left\{|z_1|^4+|z_2|^{4}<1\right\}$, where the kernels are known explicitly.
source_name: AimPL: Cauchy-Riemann equations in several variables (posed by Catlin)

title: Compute the spectrum of the … -Neumann Laplacian on the Hartogs triangle and on the Diederich-Fornaess worm domain.
statement: Compute the spectrum of the $\overline{\partial}$-Neumann Laplacian on the Hartogs triangle and on the Diederich-Fornaess worm domain. In particular, determine whether or not the corresponding spectra are discrete.
source_name: AimPL: Cauchy-Riemann equations in several variables (posed by Fu)

title: Existence of global weak solutions
source_name: AimPL: Mathematical questions in wave turbulence theory (posed by Andrea Nahmod)

title: About uniqueness
statement: Find a suitable notion of "probabilistic uniqueness" for solutions of SQG equations.
source_name: AimPL: Mathematical questions in wave turbulence theory (posed by Gigliola Staffilani)

title: Well-posedness issues
statement:
For which values of $\alpha<1$ is it possible to find global solutions to

$$
i\partial_t u = |D|^\alpha u+|u|^2u,\quad (t,x)\in \mathbb{R}\times \mathbb{T},
$$

in the energy space $H^{\alpha /2}$ ?
source_name: AimPL: Mathematical questions in wave turbulence theory (posed by Alexandru Ionescu)

title: The cubic Szeg\H{o} equation with random initial data (problem 1)
statement: Assume $\mathbb{T}^\infty$ is embedded with the uniform probability measure. Find a suitable fixed set of actions $\{I_k\}\in\Omega $ for which the $H^s$-norms of solutions to the cubic Szeg\H{o} equation ($s> 1/2$) remain almost surely bounded.
source_name: AimPL: Mathematical questions in wave turbulence theory (posed by Patrick Gérard)

title: Well-posedness theory
statement: Find the optimal space(s) in which the kinetic wave equation is locally well-posed, or at least locally well-posed around the Zakharov solution.
source_name: AimPL: Mathematical questions in wave turbulence theory (posed by Laure Saint-Raymond)

title: Lemniscates = $\Omega$ (problem 2)
statement: Minimum residual/Arnoldi lemniscates vs. $K$-spectral sets.
source_name: AimPL: Crouzeix's conjecture (posed by ?)

title: Similarity transformation approach (problem 1)
statement: Analytic approach to find $X$ to give "good" $XAX^{-1}$.
source_name: AimPL: Crouzeix's conjecture (posed by M. Kurula)

title: Ideas that do not seem to work (problem 1)
statement: Given $f$ with $\|f\|_{\infty,W(A)}=1$, can we always find $\tilde{f}$ defined on a ball $D$ enclosing $W(A)$ such that $\tilde{f}\approx f$ on $W(A)$ and $\|\tilde{f}\|_{\infty,D}=1$?
source_name: AimPL: Crouzeix's conjecture (posed by N. Trefethen)

title: A generalized related problem
statement:
Determine, by using sparse operators, if the following inequality is true for $r \in [ 1, 2 )$.

$$
\left( \frac{1}{|B|^2} \int_B \int_B \left| T_{\Omega}(f \mathbf{1}_{(2B)^c})(x) - T_{\Omega}(f \mathbf{1}_{(2B)^c})(y) \right|^2 \, dx \, dy \right)^{1/2} \lesssim_{\Omega} \sup{B' \supset B} \left( \frac{1}{|B'|} \int_{B'} |f|^r \right)^{1/r}.
$$
source_name: AimPL: Sparse domination of singular integral operators

title: Discrete operators (problem 2)
statement:
Find a sparse control over the operator $A$, that is, find $s \geq 1$, $0 < \varepsilon \leq 1$ and a sparse colection $\mathcal{S}$ such that

$$
\langle Af, g \rangle \lesssim \sum_{S \in \mathcal{S}} \langle f \rangle_{S, 2-\varepsilon} \langle g \rangle_{S, 2-\varepsilon} |S|.
$$
source_name: AimPL: Sparse domination of singular integral operators

title: Variation of spherical averages
statement:
Find $\varepsilon > 0$ and a sparse colection $\mathcal{S}$ such that

$$
\langle Vf, g \rangle \lesssim \sum_{S \in \mathcal{S}} \langle f \rangle_{S, 2+\varepsilon} \langle g \rangle_{S, \frac{4}{3}+\varepsilon} |S|.
$$
source_name: AimPL: Sparse domination of singular integral operators

title: Generalized spherical averages
statement:
Find $r,s$ and a sparse collection $\mathcal{S}$ such that

$$
\langle \sup_{t \geq 0} A_t f, g \rangle \lesssim \sum_{S \in \mathcal{S}} \langle f \rangle_{r,S} \langle g \rangle_{r,S} |S|.
$$
source_name: AimPL: Sparse domination of singular integral operators

title: End point sparse bounds
statement:
Find domination by sparse operators at the end points for the lacunary spherical maximal average

$$
\mathcal{M}_{lac} f = \left| \sup_{k} A_{2^k} f \right|.
$$
source_name: AimPL: Sparse domination of singular integral operators

title: Sparse adapted to the geometry
statement: Find sparse bounds for the lacunary spherical maximal average, using sparse forms given by sets better adapted to the geometry of the problem.
source_name: AimPL: Sparse domination of singular integral operators

title: Radial weights
statement: Find sparse bounds adapted to estimates with respect to radial weights and/or radial functions.
source_name: AimPL: Sparse domination of singular integral operators

title: Bilinear spherical maximal operator
statement: Find a correct way to define a sparse bound for the bilinear spherical maximal averaging operator.
source_name: AimPL: Sparse domination of singular integral operators

title: Lower bound for the square function
statement:
Find a sparse domination proof for the lower bound

$$
\| f \|_{L^2(W)} \lesssim [W]_{A_2}^{1/2} \| S f \|_{L^2(W)}.
$$
source_name: AimPL: Sparse domination of singular integral operators

title: Sparse operators
statement: It is necessary to find the correct notion of a sparse operator in a two or more parameters setting.
source_name: AimPL: Sparse domination of singular integral operators

title: Exponential results
statement:
Determine if we have the following

$$
\iint_{\mathbb{T} \times \mathbb{T}} \exp \left( \frac{|H_1 H_2 f|}{\mathcal{M}_1 \mathcal{M}_2 f} \right)^{1/2} \, dx \, dy < \infty.
$$
source_name: AimPL: Sparse domination of singular integral operators

title: Representation theorem
statement: Find a representation theorem for Calder\' on-Zygmund operators with Zygmund dilations that allows to produce an sparse bound by dominating the Haar shifts.
source_name: AimPL: Sparse domination of singular integral operators

title: Separated bump conjecture
statement:
Determine if the conditions

$$
\begin{cases}
|Q|^{\alpha /d} \langle u \rangle_Q^{1/p} \| \sigma^{1/p'} \|_{\Phi, Q} \leq C, & \Phi \in B_p, \\
|Q|^{\alpha / d} \| u^{1/p} \|_{\Psi, Q} \langle \sigma \rangle_Q^{1/p'} \leq C, & \Psi \in B_{p'},
\end{cases}
$$

imply that $I_{\alpha}$ is bounded from $L^p(\sigma)$ to $L^p(u)$.
source_name: AimPL: Sparse domination of singular integral operators

title: $A_2$ conjecture in non-homogeneous setting
source_name: AimPL: Sparse domination of singular integral operators

title: Sparse domination of $\widetilde{\mathcal{M}}$
statement: Can we find a sparse operator that controls the maximal function $\widetilde{\mathcal{M}}$ related to the Tolsa $Z_p(\mu)$ condition.
source_name: AimPL: Sparse domination of singular integral operators

title: Different characterizations of $\widetilde{\mathcal{M}}$
statement: Find another characterization for the boundedness of $\widetilde{\mathcal{M}}$ on $L^p(w)$ similar to the work of Jawerth, in terms of an $A_p$ condition and boundedness of two weighted maximal operators.
source_name: AimPL: Sparse domination of singular integral operators

title: Heat trace asymptotics for the Steklov problem on orbifolds, polygons and polyhedra
statement:
a) Prove existence of heat trace asymptotics for orbifolds, polygons or polyhedrons.

b) Compute the heat trace coefficient in those settings.
source_name: AimPL: Steklov eigenproblems (posed by Emily Dryden)

title: Can one find the same relations for the Helmholtz case?
statement: Can one find the same relations for the Helmholtz case? For the Steklov-Maxwell case?
source_name: AimPL: Steklov eigenproblems (posed by Nilima Nigam)

title: Steklov spectrum for the Lamé operator
statement:
On a domain with corners, find the behaviour in $\kappa$ of the Steklov problem for the Lamé operator,

$$
\begin{cases}\Delta u + \kappa \nabla \operatorname{div} u = 0 \\ \sum_k c_{j_k} \frac{\partial u_k}{\partial x_j} = \lambda u_j \end{cases}
$$
source_name: AimPL: Steklov eigenproblems (posed by Michael Levitin)

title: What is the Steklov-Maxwell problem?
statement: Find the most natural formulation of the Steklov-Maxwell problem.
source_name: AimPL: Steklov eigenproblems (posed by Nilima Nigam)

title: Symmetry of Steklov optimisers
statement: Show analytically that the actual maximisers to the Steklov problem do exhibit those symmetries.
source_name: AimPL: Steklov eigenproblems (posed by Iosif Polterovich)

title: Eigenvalue degeneration for Riemannian metrics
statement: In dimension $d = 3$, can one find a sequence of Riemannian metrics such that both the boundary and interior volume stay bounded but such that $\sigma_1 \to \infty$.
source_name: AimPL: Steklov eigenproblems (posed by Ailana Fraser)

title: Eigenvalue optimisation in dimension $2$
statement:
a) Is the $4 \pi$ bound sharp? If not, find a sharp bound.

b) Find the maximising domain or show that such a domain does not exist.
source_name: AimPL: Steklov eigenproblems (posed by Jean Lagacé and Iosif Polterovich)

title: Can one hear the genus of a surface from its Steklov spectrum
statement:
a) Given a Riemannian surface with boundary, can one obtain its genus from the Steklov spectrum?

b)? Given a closed surface embedded in $\mathbb{R}^3$, can one determine the genus of the boundary from the Steklov problem in its interior?
source_name: AimPL: Steklov eigenproblems (posed by Iosif Polterovich and Leonid Parnovski)

title: Directional hot spots conjecture
statement:
Can one always find a direction $\mathbf{e}\in\mathbb{R}^2$ such that
 

$$
\mathbf{e}\cdot \nabla u >0 \quad \text{in }\Omega?
$$
source_name: AimPL: Shape optimization with surface interactions (posed by T. Beck)

title: Hermite-Hadamard inequality in higher dimensions
statement: Find the optimal constants in the inequalities.
source_name: AimPL: Shape optimization with surface interactions (posed by S. Steinerberger)

title: Asymptotic partitioning problems
statement: Find conditions for problems involving optimal $N$-partitions of a planar domain such that one observes in the limit $N\to \infty$ a packing of hexagons.
source_name: AimPL: Shape optimization with surface interactions (posed by K. Burdzy)
